title: Invite alumni
description: Invite alumni and students, parents or teachers you know. An individual invitation is for one person (a strong recommendation); a year-group invitation is a link for up to 10 people, e.g. for a class LINE group. Both last 30 days. The class you give helps the committee check and approve faster.
cohortHint: As far as you know. The committee uses it when checking.
name: Their name (optional)
nameHint: A note for you, and a help for the committee.
created: Invitation link created. Send it to them (works once, for 30 days).
linkHint: This link can't be shown again. Copy it now or send it on LINE.
shareText: You're invited to the AIS Alumni members' site. Sign up here (this link works once).

errors.tooMany: Too many unused individual invitations (100 max). Cancel unused ones first.
errors.gradeOpen: You already have a year-group link for this class (one at a time). Use it up or cancel it first.

INDIVIDUAL.title: Individual (recommendation)
INDIVIDUAL.hint: A one-time link for one person you know well. The committee treats it as your recommendation. Create as many as you need.

GRADE.title: Year group (up to 10)
GRADE.hint: A link to share with a class, e.g. in its LINE group. Up to 10 people can use it. One open link per class at a time.

createdGrade: Year-group link created. Share it with the group (up to 10 people, valid for 30 days).
shareTextGrade: You're invited to the AIS Alumni member site. Sign up here (this link works for up to 10 people).
